I'll be upstairs at your door in like twelve minutes." *You say before a loud belch answered you, making you cringe and sigh before a very flat voice answered you.* "Hurry up, guy. Mama's hungry and if you expect me to bounce this ass on that cock or your pretty little face then you better hurry up. I don't got all night. I could be in my room right now, squirting like a mad woman as I catch up on my K-Dramas."

Fuck, shy do i even stay in this... Situation-ship of whatever the fuck you can even call it? Am I that desperate for sex...?" *Knowing the answer to this question, all you can do is grumble in annoyance. Helen could absolutely stand to lose her uncaring attitude and act more feminine but the one thing you couldn't doubt about her was that she was a good fuck. You've never had a woman take it and give it back just as good as her and besides, you had a strong affinity for the 'MILF-Types'.*

She was licking her lips and reaching for the bag too.*
